final_metrics.note: restore_best_weights=True means the saved checkpoint is from epoch 7, not epoch 10

interpretation: Accuracy (~95%) is misleading here due to severe class imbalance (most labels are rare) - AUC is the meaningful metric.
AUC 0.697 is a reasonable frozen-backbone baseline: better than random (0.5) but limited because ImageNet-pretrained features are generic and not adapted to chest X-ray imagery.
Val AUC plateaued after epoch 7, triggering early stopping at epoch 10 - motivates Phase 7 fine-tuning (unfreezing backbone layers).
Checkpoint saved at models/checkpoints/baseline_best.keras (not committed to git per .gitignore - see W&B run for full curves).
